question_text: What is the maximum permissible width of a vehicle including load (excluding vehicles with farming or forestry products and refrigerator vehicles)?
comment: The width of thy vehicle (except vehicles agricultural or forestry products and refrigerated vehicles) including cargo, should be 2.55 m at most.

question_text: What is the maximum permissible height of a vehicle including load (excluding vehicles with farming or forestry products)?
comment: The amount of your vehicle, including cargo (except vehicles agricultural or forestry products) must be at most 4 m.

chapter_name: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
question_text: A load extending beyond the back of the vehicle must be marked. Which means are allowed during the day?

options.text: A bright red flag of at least 30 x 30 cm held apart by a crossbar
A bright red sign of at least 30 x 30 cm, pendulously mounted transverse to the direction you are travelling in
An orange warning plate

correct_answers.text: A bright red flag of at least 30 x 30 cm held apart by a crossbar
A bright red sign of at least 30 x 30 cm, pendulously mounted transverse to the direction you are travelling in

comment: By day following means are permitted at a rearwardly protruding charge: A minimum of 30 x 30 cm large, bright red, transversely to the direction of travel pendulum suspended shield and a bright red, at least 30 x 30 cm large flag held apart by a cross bar. Only the orange warning sign is not enough.

question_text: What precautionary measures must be taken before putting a loading crane into operation?

options.text: Secure the vehicle against tilting with the aid of the side supports
There must not be any electrical lines in the swivelling range
Check whether support is absolutely necessary on the sides

correct_answers.text: Secure the vehicle against tilting with the aid of the side supports
There must not be any electrical lines in the swivelling range

comment: Before putting a loading crane you need to be sure that in the swivel range, no electrical lines are and you have to use the lateral supports the vehicle from overturning.

question_text: What are the conditions on which you are allowed to carry out loading on the edge of the roadway?

options.text: You are not allowed to impair traffic safety
You must not ignore any "no stopping" signs
During loading, you are allowed to endanger traffic slightly

correct_answers.text: You are not allowed to impair traffic safety
You must not ignore any "no stopping" signs

comment: If you would like to perform at the roadside a loading operation, please pay attention to stopping restrictions and that the traffic safety is not compromised.

Ensure the load is kept at the necessary temperature

comment: In a breakdown with a hot transported cargo, you should organize help ensure the necessary for the charge temperature and secure vehicle.

question_text: What are the rules with which you have to comply when you transport refrigerated goods?

If the refrigeration fails, take appropriate measures to preserve the load
No special rules

If the refrigeration fails, take appropriate measures to preserve the load

comment: In a Kühlguttransport please make sure to constantly meet the following the specified temperature and the failure of the cooling appropriate measures to maintain the charge.

question_text: When transporting certain goods, special regulations must be observed. For which goods does this apply?

For waste
For live animals

correct_answers.text: For dangerous goods
For waste
For live animals

comment: Both for waste materials, as well as live animals and dangerous goods Special regulations must be observed. All answers are correct.

question_text: How do you mark a load when it extends laterally by more than 0.4 m beyond the side lights of the vehicle?

options.text: By white side lights to the front and red lateral light to the back
By red side reflectors to the front and red side reflectors to the rear
Marking is not necessary up to a lateral distance of 1 m

correct_answers.text: By white side lights to the front and red lateral light to the back

comment: The marking on the side of more than 0.4 m above the vehicle running lights also exceptional charge, you should side forward and with white and carry the side to the rear with red lights.

question_text: Where can you find guidelines concerning the transport and securing of loads on vehicles?

In the generally accepted technical standards on securing loads
In the registration certificate Part II

chapter_name: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
question_text: You are transporting a "groupage" cargo load containing transport units of varying sizes and weight. How should you secure this load?

options.text: By using partitions to sub-divide the loading area into smaller segments
By using an interlocking arrangement of the transport units
By ensuring minimum spacing is kept between the transport units

correct_answers.text: By using partitions to sub-divide the loading area into smaller segments
By using an interlocking arrangement of the transport units

comment: Do you drive a load handling with different sized and heavy transport units, please pay attention to the loading area dividing into small segments with separating elements and that you secure by positive placement of the transport units, the charge.

question_text: You are transporting logs. The driving route means you have to drive along poor quality roads. What do you have to do?

options.text: - regularly check that the load is secure
- adapt my speed to the carriageway and the load
- ensure that the frictional forces between the logs are reduced to the minimum possible level

correct_answers.text: - regularly check that the load is secure
- adapt my speed to the carriageway and the load

comment: When tree trunks transport over bad roads, you should regularly review and adjust your driving speed to the road to the cargo securing loads.

question_text: What do you have to ensure when taking receipt of a load, if it is expected that transporting this load will create a risk?

- adapt my driving speed to the condition of the load
- conditionally take receipt of the load

correct_answers.text: - refuse to accept the load if I am unable to avert the risk

comment: Accepting the award of damaged cargo, you should note that the charge must reject, if you can not avert the danger.
